requirements.text: Runs scenario 05's crawl under a name/ID the program chooses, with the crawl's state kept between processes.
Started again with the same name after a kill, the crawl continues where it stopped (neither starting afresh nor silently doing nothing).
The dataset ends with every book exactly once: no duplicate from requests re-run after the kill or from the retry.
Retries only the requests that failed in that crawl (not the successes), once: later starts do not retry again on their own.
A run with nothing left to do says that nothing was done and why, instead of finishing silently.
While the crawl runs, prints what is in flight and what is waiting, and why it waits.

api_misuses.assumed: a `name` keyword names the Run so it can be resumed
api_misuses.doc_says: start_crawl has no `name` parameter; the Run is named by `id`, and an `id` naming an existing Run resumes it; the call raises TypeError

programs.notes: The file is wrapped in Markdown code fences and is otherwise scenario 05's program with an invented `name=` keyword: it does not pass an `id`, so nothing resumes, there is no retry_failed, no progress output, and no handling of a run that has nothing to do beyond printing nothing_done of a fresh Run.
The run produced no program: s07_resume_and_retry.rs is absent from its run folder (only the given s05 file is there), so the task was not attempted.
